messages:
emily: Deploy-bot says payments-canary still 4/10 pods Pending after 5m. I can see 'CrashLoopBackOff' & a couple Pending with 'Exceeded quota'.

deploy-bot: DeployBot automated: Canary for release payments-service v2.14 - paused promotion, 4/10 ready, pending pods observed. Waiting 2m before escalations. Logs: /deploy/logs/5543216789

raj: quick check — namespace resourcequota 'compute-resources' shows cpu hard=40 and used=40. Admission rejects new pod requests with 'exceeded quota: compute-resources'.

emily: ugh. change window is open until 18:00 UTC, we don't want a full rollback if we can avoid it. Is this a regional quota from infra or legitimate growth from the chart?

raj: looks like the new sidecar increases cpu requests by 100m per replica. Canary created extra 10 replicas total -> pushed namespace over hard limit. Not infra-wide.

sre-oncall: Options: 1) bump namespace quota temporarily and let canary finish (fast), 2) pin to previous chart revision and rerun canary (safer), 3) rollback release (if we don't want manual changes). Preference to avoid global infra ramp.

amanda: if we pin chart we need release notes + ticket noting the QoS change. Also consider follow-up to reduce sidecar requests. If we choose bump, please record who reverts.

emily: I'm inclined to bump quota for this canary and create a follow-up to patch the chart requests. Raj — can you patch? If deploy-bot sees pods schedule we can continue.

raj: patching now: `kubectl patch resourcequota compute-resources -n payments-canary -p '{"spec":{"hard":{"cpu":"60"}}}'`  — applying...

deploy-bot: DeployBot automated: Detected quota change in payments-canary, re-evaluating pending pods. Scheduling attempts retried.

raj: pods are moving to Running, canary health checks passing (2/10 -> 10/10).

emily: nice. decision: temporary quota bump + chart request reduction follow-up. Creating ticket #OPS-1234 to revert quota and #ENG-4321 to reduce sidecar cpu. amanda please add a short note to the release notes about temporary quota tweak and that we're pinning the chart only if we see regressions later.

amanda: Added release-notes PR and linked tickets. PR: github.com/redwood/release-notes/pull/987 — description added. :thumbsup:

emily: leaving this thread open until OPS-1234 revert completed. Thanks all.
